title: Welcome to Oak Hill School
instructions: Okul müdürü yeni velilere okulu tanıtıyor. Uzun bir metin; saatler, kurallar ve günleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to Oak Hill School. I'm Mrs Turner, the head teacher.

script.speaker: head
script.text: We have about four hundred students and thirty teachers.

script.speaker: head
script.text: School starts at eight forty-five, but the doors open at eight fifteen. Please do not bring children before that.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Lessons finish at three fifteen from Monday to Thursday. On Fridays, school finishes earlier, at two.

script.speaker: head
script.text: All students must wear the school uniform: a blue jumper and grey trousers or a grey skirt.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Students can't use mobile phones during the school day. They can keep them in their bags, but they must be off.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Lunch is in the dining hall. It costs two pounds fifty a day, or children can bring lunch from home.

script.speaker: head
script.text: After school, there are clubs every day: football, art, music and chess. The chess club is the most popular!

script.speaker: head
script.text: Our first parents' meeting is on the twentieth of October.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Now, please follow the teachers for a tour of the building.

questions.prompt: What time do the school doors open?
questions.feedback: Kapılar sekizi çeyrek geçe (eight fifteen) açılıyor; dersler 8:45'te başlıyor.
questions.evidence: the doors open at eight fifteen.

questions.prompt: What time does school finish on Fridays?
questions.feedback: Cuma günleri daha erken, saat ikide (at two) bitiyor.
questions.evidence: On Fridays, school finishes earlier, at two.

questions.prompt: What colour is the school jumper?
questions.feedback: Kazak mavi (a blue jumper); pantolon ya da etek gri.
questions.evidence: a blue jumper and grey trousers or a grey skirt.

questions.prompt: What is the rule about mobile phones?
options: Students must leave them at home.
Students can use them at lunch.
They must be off in their bags.
questions.feedback: Telefonlar çantada kalabilir ama kapalı (off) olmalı.
questions.evidence: They can keep them in their bags, but they must be off.

questions.prompt: Which club is the most popular?
questions.evidence: The chess club is the most popular!
